ActiveCampaign

Build lifecycle journeys with clear rules and ownership.

AOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

ActiveCampaign supports audience segmentation, marketing automation, and documented contact and deal APIs. MoreSpace can create a reviewed lifecycle process that connects customer signals with relevant follow-up, updates CRM context, and gives the team clear visibility into message eligibility and business outcomes.

Useful outputs

  • Segmented contacts and reviewed automation journey conditions
  • Assigned follow-up actions linked to eligible customer signals
  • Reporting views that join messaging outcomes with pipeline progress

Where we can apply it

  • Subscribed contact → welcome automation → engagement signal → next relevant step.
  • Qualified lead → approved deal update → sales task → opportunity review.
  • Inactive customer → eligibility check → re-engagement journey → customer outcome report.
01

Use case 1

Create welcome, nurture, and re-engagement journeys for eligible contacts.

02

Use case 2

Map approved contact and deal updates into customer lifecycle rules.

03

Use case 3

Connect automation outcomes with sales follow-up and conversion reporting.

Inputs we need

  • Subscribed contacts and approved customer lifecycle definitions
  • Reviewed email assets, offers, and journey triggering rules
  • CRM field mappings, sales owners, and follow-up responsibilities

Delivery sequence

  • Define entry, exit, suppression, and handoff rules for each journey.
  • Configure contacts and automations, then test representative customer states.
  • Activate reviewed journeys and compare engagement with qualified business outcomes.

Expert review points

  • Approve audience selection, message frequency, and offers before journey activation.
  • Review overlapping automation rules and sales ownership before enabling follow-up.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • Journey conversion rate
  • Click rate
